```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      results = "asis")

# This Rmd mirrors the design in Portfolio Review.html exactly. The
# section-render functions (.rs_render_pr_*) emit the same .pf-* markup
# that the Reports tab preview uses, so the rendered output is identical.
cfg       <- params$cfg       %||% list()
rv        <- params$rv        %||% list()
ctx <- list(
  cfg              = cfg,
  rv               = rv,
  report_data      = params$report_data %||% list(),
  portfolio        = params$portfolio   %||% list(),
  period_label     = params$period_label,
  prepared_by      = params$prepared_by,
  reviewed_by      = params$reviewed_by
)

trial_label <- cfg$short_name %||% toupper(cfg$code %||% "Trial")
period      <- params$period_label %||% format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")

render_pr <- function(id) {
  s <- report_section_by_id(id)
  if (is.null(s)) return("")
  tryCatch(s$render(ctx),
           error = function(e) sprintf("<p>Failed: %s</p>", e$message))
}
```

# Page 1 — Trial Update Summary

```{r page1}
cat(sprintf("<div class='pf-page'>"))
cat(sprintf("<div class='pf-page-meta'><span>Birmingham Clinical Trials Unit</span><span>Version 4.0 · %s</span></div>",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(period)))
cat(render_pr("pr_trial_summary"))
cat(render_pr("pr_review_progress"))
cat(render_pr("pr_rag_status"))
cat(sprintf("<div class='pf-page-foot'><span>%s · Portfolio Review · %s</span><span>Page 1 of 2</span></div>",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(trial_label), htmltools::htmlEscape(period)))
cat("</div>")
```
